say:1:1533104001:1.text: Dull. Dull. Dull. A safe and sorry choice. Just another gutless customer, afraid to taste anything new.
say:1:1533104001:1.source_cn: 无趣、无趣、无趣。无趣的选择。没有美食探索欲的庸俗食客。
say:1:1533104001:1.male: Dull. Dull. Dull. A safe and sorry choice. Just another gutless customer, afraid to taste anything new.
say:1:1533104001:1.female: Dull. Dull. Dull. A safe and sorry choice. Just another gutless customer, afraid to taste anything new.

say:2:1533104002:1.text: *Sigh*... Alright, wait here. I'll be back with your order soon.
say:2:1533104002:1.male: *Sigh*... Alright, wait here. I'll be back with your order soon.
say:2:1533104002:1.female: *Sigh*... Alright, wait here. I'll be back with your order soon.

narration:3:1533104003:0.text: After a short time, Goldpot emerges from the kitchen, your freshly prepared meal in hand.
narration:3:1533104003:0.source_cn: 一段时间后，金点将你点的菜端了回来
narration:3:1533104003:0.male: After a short time, Goldpot emerges from the kitchen, your freshly prepared meal in hand.
narration:3:1533104003:0.female: After a short time, Goldpot emerges from the kitchen, your freshly prepared meal in hand.

narration:4:1533104004:0.text: Let it be said: Goldpot's got a mouth on her, but her skills are for real. This is, without doubt, the most magnificent meal you have ever had. You devour your food...
narration:4:1533104004:0.source_cn: 不得不说，金点嘴巴毒，但手艺确实一流，这是你吃到的最美...
narration:4:1533104004:0.male: Let it be said: Goldpot's got a mouth on her, but her skills are for real. This is, without doubt, the most magnificent meal you have ever had. You devour your food...
narration:4:1533104004:0.female: Let it be said: Goldpot's got a mouth on her, but her skills are for real. This is, without doubt, the most magnificent meal you have ever had. You devour your food...

say:5:1533104005:1.text: Good job cleaning your plate. Come find me again if you're hungry.
say:5:1533104005:1.source_cn: 不浪费是好习惯。下次，你可以再来找我点菜。
say:5:1533104005:1.male: Good job cleaning your plate. Come find me again if you're hungry.
say:5:1533104005:1.female: Good job cleaning your plate. Come find me again if you're hungry.
